direction.content_form: Date-led public event board with a large three-part visual explanation of material, remaking and mutual sharing.
direction.whole_expression_style: Bright contemporary civic graphics: precise flat illustration, strong calendar hierarchy, direct headings and three practical stations. Accessible mainstream communication with adult proportions.

dimensions.expression: Translate recognisable making into a direct illustrated invitation.
dimensions.image_crop: Replace central portrait hands with three substantial landscape scenes, each readable as an object/action.
dimensions.color: One light ground and limited saturated accents separate pictures from facts.
dimensions.layout: Activity band bridges identity above and usable facts below; abandon portrait title/icon/footer proportions.
dimensions.information_grouping: Contiguous lower groups answer destination/arrival, participation and preparation in one sweep.
dimensions.type_roles: Expressive weight belongs to the date; readable regular sans replaces brush/serif imitation.
dimensions.material: Uniform flat edges and controlled line weight keep the diagrams coherent.
dimensions.emotion: Direct subject recognition welcomes newcomers without a children’s mascot.

reference_transfer.intentional_non_transfer: No beige/wavy frame, brush title, copied hands, portrait geometry or tiny source-fact sizing.

layout.large_relationship: Large date/time upper-left; compact name/English upper-right. Activity heads one wide 108 px-high visual band. Three same-baseline practical groups below provide complete attendance/participation/preparation.
layout.alignment: Upper anchors x24 and x430. Lower groups start x24,248,470 at y277. The sequence follows their left-to-right direction, without numbered cards.

visible_transition_cues: Three plain aligned starts support a complete lower sweep.

visible_reading_route.planning_retrieval_risk: The image sequence may absorb attention before the lower stations; preparation could be overlooked beside reassurance.
visible_reading_route.relationship_repair_priority: Keep lower groups aligned and close to the image band; reduce image or date area before shrinking useful facts.
visible_reading_route.evidence_scope: Trace of proposed 720×405 geometry and literal strings, supported by local font metrics. No rendered poster, viewer retrieval task or generated object correspondence has been observed.

typography.system: Robust public-information sans; bold date numerals, semibold name, regular facts.
typography.dominant_role: 42 px calendar entry, not a giant title.
typography.wrap_logic: Every entry one line; longest lower-right strings receive 226 px width.
typography.punctuation: Keep full event range; locate the separate entrance time with the destination.

image.scene_action_relation_crop: Band [24,149,672,108]. Left: complete adult T-shirt about 118×100 px with a bounded usable body panel. Middle: substantial panel folded into a pouch with clear mouth and side seams. Right: two finished pouches on two simple opposing adult palms, one offered toward the other. Shared baseline gives source→remade object→mutual sharing. No printed numbers/labels or tiny decorative tools.

necessary_features: Source has curved lower hem, one broad contrasting band and a small non-letter geometric repair patch inside its body panel.
Middle pouch retains band/patch placement within its front, with separate mouth and side seams.
That pouch recurs in sharing, opposite a different participant’s finished pouch.
intentional_changes: Torso panel folds and gains sewn sides; collar/sleeves disappear.
Hem can become mouth edge; patch may crop at seam but remains on the same side of the band.
transformation.relationship_limit: Concise source/result/share sequence; no needle through fingers or complex simultaneous cutting action.

direction.material: Opaque flat fills, consistent dark outline, only meaningful folds/seams. No raised shapes, shadow cards or paper effects.

color.image: Deep teal, ochre panel band, coral sleeve accent.
color.role: Contrast supports reading; accents identify corresponding fabric and sharing ends without colour-only coding.

direction.emotion: Open, practical, adult and socially inviting.

nearest_direction_stripped_comparison.comparison: M2 remains date-first with an ordered full-width three-part image band and three same-baseline stations. M5 remains English-masthead-first with one compact upper-right comparison graphic and unequal lower attendance/participation blocks. M2 explains by sequence; M5 identifies through a bold emblem and asymmetry.

common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.

T-shirt-to-pouch upcycling and sharing completed pouches must be visibly connected, with an approachable adult daytime hobby-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
